readme: Track the bounded Shadergrove shader-tooling initiative. P0: shared GLSL analysis and a SPIRV-VM/WASM feasibility proof. P1: semantic IntelliSense, frozen rendering snapshots, pass/pixel inspection and the fragment debugger. P2: watches, static statistics and bounded frame analysis. P3: a desktop DAP bridge. All issues begin in Todo; move them through In Progress and Done as work is delivered. Dependencies, acceptance criteria, upstream references and deferred scope are documented in each issue. GPU timing and VM instruction heatmaps must remain distinct. Debugger support depends on demonstrated VM/WebGL fidelity. HLSL, compute, geometry/tessellation and a full 3D pipeline are deferred.
shortDescription: GLSL IntelliSense, render inspection, SPIRV-VM debugging and shader analysis inspired by SHADERed.
title: Shadergrove — Shader tooling & debugger
